source: Kickoff Workflow Mapping Sprint, Board 4 (Ops, PO amendments), 12 Sep 2026, plus the program's Week 1 lesson that lead time and payment terms belong to the Category Manager. The 2K threshold and its currency are not confirmed yet.

rules.plainEnglish: Price change under 5 percent and under 2K: the Ops Buyer can change it in SAP.
Price change over 5 percent: the Category Manager must approve.
Any quantity change goes to the Planner.
Lead time changes, payment terms and other commercial terms belong to the Category Manager, not Ops.
